settings.name: Waleed Asif (Lahore)
settings.title: Clean, minimal, and incredible value at 16.5k
settings.content: At Rs. 16,500 for a 3-piece marble table set, this is unbeatable value! Clean minimalist lines, very solid white marble tops, and the crescent base looks super modern.

settings.name: Sadaf Jamil (Islamabad)
settings.title: Perfect for modern Scandinavian-style lounges
settings.content: If you love clean, uncluttered Scandinavian or contemporary decor, this table set is ideal. The satin gold finish is refined and understated.

settings.name: Bilal Murtaza (Karachi)
settings.title: Lightweight enough to move around, sturdy enough to hold heavy trays
settings.content: The nesting stools slide out effortlessly when we have family over for tea. Highly practical and looks elegant.

settings.name: Hina Qasim (Faisalabad)
settings.title: Very happy with the design
settings.content: Simple, chic, and functional. Arrived well boxed in wooden crates. The white marble is easy to wipe clean.

settings.name: Danish Rauf (Gujranwala)
settings.title: Precision welding and smooth gold coating
settings.content: The joints are cleanly welded and the gold finish is even throughout. Very solid construction.

settings.name: Nazia Pervez (Rawalpindi)
settings.title: Transforms the whole lounge
settings.content: We replaced our old bulky wooden coffee table with this 3-piece set and the room feels so much bigger and more modern now.

settings.name: Hamid Raza (Multan)
settings.title: Delighted with Gull e Gulzar quality
settings.content: Second time ordering from Gull e Gulzar and once again they delivered excellence. Fast shipping and courteous delivery service.
